## Change type

- [ ] Feature or bug fix for `develop`
- [ ] Hotfix for `main` (remember to sync it back to `develop`)
- [ ] Release or branch synchronization

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets the correct branch (`develop` for normal changes, `main` only for hotfixes or release PRs).
- [ ] The PR title uses an allowed Conventional Commit type.
- [ ] Generated files are up to date when applicable.
- [ ] Tests and documentation have been updated when needed.
